sections.title: Overview
sections.content: PySwissShef is a collection of automation scripts designed to handle various helper duties, local script runners, and developer pipelines. The web lab executes these directly within StackBlitz's WebContainers technology, spinning up a Node.js process and Pyodide/Python environment in the browser.

sections.title: Local Installation
sections.content:
To run this locally, clone the repository and run: 

`git clone https://github.com/iarxii/PySwissShef.git` 
`cd PySwissShef` 
`pip install -r requirements.txt`

sections.title: Available Kitchen Recipes
sections.content:
• `chef-lint`: Automatically formats Python code using Ruff.
• `chef-test`: Runs the unit test suites with coverage reports.
• `chef-serve`: Launches local demo environments.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: AICodex is an agentic interface designed to demonstrate real-time planning, reflection, and tools orchestration. Under the hood, it utilizes LangGraph and Groq's high-speed LPU inference to achieve latency under 200ms per agent step.

sections.title: Capabilities
sections.content:
• **Dual-Agent Dialogue**: Multi-agent consensus finding and task delegation.
• **Dynamic Tools Usage**: Real-time tool-calling logic and runtime execution logs.
• **Strict Type Enforcement**: TypeScript-first structure ensuring type-safe agent payloads.

sections.title: Configuration & Keys
sections.content: The sandbox operates with pre-configured developer API tokens. For full access to custom LLM endpoints, click settings within the portal to input your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq API keys.
